claims.explanation: Tyrphostin AG-99 is an EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitor, so selective killing is most plausibly driven by EGFR dependency: activating EGFR mutations or high EGFR expression sensitize cells, while mutations causing bypass of EGFR signaling (e.g., KRAS, MET, CTNNB1, NF2, CDKN2A) confer protection. Other mutations (PTEN, ARID1A, SMARCA4) may modulate response but are less certain.
